databaseRetirementReason: Original owned runtime receipt disappeared; no successor discovery or DB sampling.
limits: External operational sampling only; no tests, app/provider/DB/config mutations, SQL text, credentials, environment or process argv captured.

Cgroup/process cumulative CPU and RSS do not measure event-loop delay or prove saturation. Process CPU/RSS is sampled only for cgroup.procs membership, which may omit nested child cgroups. Docker PostgreSQL/Realtime container CPU outside that unit is not captured.

When original runtime owner receipt disappears, database sampling retires and stays retired; cgroup observation continues until unit exits and may include subsequent validation lanes. No successor runtime is discovered or queried.
PG wait/lock snapshots and query age do not measure pg-pool checkout wait, SQL execution duration or transient waits between samples. Null backend metadata/permission limits stay explicit.
Sampling itself adds docker/psql/backend and filesystem overhead. databaseReadMs includes docker startup and transport, not PostgreSQL execution alone.
Native helper process timeout15s bounds the observer subprocess only and is unrelated to HV; timed-out reads are missing samples.
Initial source file hashes are verified; final only HEAD and manifest hashes are checked. No full source immutability claim without separate replay provenance.
No numeric performance SLA or release/HV verdict is established. Exact per-command browser/server correlation remains separate.
qualification: Partial optional operational evidence only. Observer terminated on owned unit exit; a collected unit has no surviving authoritative application exit status here.
